title: v0.21 continuation baseline and qualification
summary: The recovered continuation baseline is oorexx_terminal_machine_v0.21. It adds checkpoint-bound emulator instruction/event orchestration while retaining the persistent one-session broker/service line and all live TN5250 authority/secrecy rules unchanged.
invariants: Product release number and Semantic Source Control source level are independent.
SSC is supplementary evidence because the full v0.21 production scan exceeded the recorded certification window.
Qualification was performed under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196.
No PUB400 login was performed for v0.21 package acceptance.
